device.model: CoDeSys pneumatic valve controller of the Fish Sorter v2
device.name: Fish Sorter pneumatic valve controller (Wago, Modbus TCP)

facts.text: The hardware README lists CODESYS valve control code for use with Wago valve controllers among what the hardware directory includes
ValveController communicates with the Wago valve controller to actuate the pressure and vacuum valves; the Wago controller was programmed with CoDeSys to receive specific function codes
ValveController stores the config mapping it was given on self.config
ValveController._connect creates a ModbusTcpClient with the configured host and port, timeout=5 and retries=3
read_register returns read_holding_registers of count registers at start_address + add_offset and re-raises any exception
write_register writes value to start_address + add_offset and returns the reply; on an exception it closes the client, reconnects and retries the same write once
The upstream valve test checks rr.isError() and ExceptionResponse after a read: a Modbus exception reply is not a Python exception but a valid Modbus message
The upstream valve test writes a function code to 12288 + ADDRESS_OFFSET and reads the same register back
The shipped pneumatic config sets start_address 12288 and the offsets draw time 0, expel time 2, function 4, function echo 6 and idle type 14
The shipped function codes are idle_atm 0, draw 2, expel 4, press_off 8, press_on 9, vac_on 16, vac_off 17 and func_idle 128
PickingPipette.connect creates a ZaberController unless one was passed, creates the ValveController and writes idle_atm to the func_idle_type register
PickingPipette.idle ('Toggles to idle atmospheric pressure') writes func_idle to the function register
PickingPipette.pressure(False) writes press_off and pressure(True) writes press_on
PickingPipette.vacuum(False) writes vac_off and vacuum(True) writes vac_on
PickingPipette.draw_time and expel_time write a time in ms to the draw-time and expel-time registers
PickingPipette._pipette_wait sleeps in steps of max(0.05, t/3) and leaves its loop early when vc.read_register(address_offset) == 0; it writes nothing
PickingPipette._valve_cmd writes the register and then calls _pipette_wait on the same offset
PickingPipette.disconnect moves the pipette and homes x and y, then writes idle_atm to the func_idle_type register and closes both connections; it writes nothing to the function register

safe_state.description: idle code (func_idle, 128 in the shipped config) written and taken by the controller (function register back at 0, echo register equal to the code); per the CoDeSys program text in the clone that step sets its Press and Vacuum outputs off (Press OFF, Atmos ON); not a sensed valve position, and the Zaber stage is not stopped (not covered)
